name: Monopolar Curved Scissors (Hot Shears)
capabilities_basis: Curved shearing blades. Monopolar energy needs the tip cover accessory and an energy generator, neither of which is simulated. The blades are not a grasper: no grasp or retraction capability.

kinematics.jaw_pivot_basis: scripts/build/measure_jaw_pivot.py 420179: both blade meshes have their pin hole (r 1.04 mm) at y = 2.45 mm of the dvrk_model jaw frame, x = 0.02 mm. The dvrk_model tip_179 xacro rotates the blades about y = 0, which would pull the two pin holes 2.4 mm apart at 1 rad opening. The same check on tip_006 finds the pin at y = 0. The blades keep their place; only the rotation axis moves.
kinematics.tool_tip_basis: The scene tcp is the geometric blade tip (13.05 mm from the yaw axis). The dvrk_model / ISI tool tip (15.5 mm) is kept in the install manifest for reference.
